text: Takasago Thermal Engineering Co., Ltd.'s major shareholders as of 30 September 2025 are The Master Trust Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 10.29%), Nippon Life Insurance (6.83%), State Street Bank and Trust Company 505001 (6.31%), the Takasago Thermal Engineering employee shareholding association (4.73%), Custody Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 4.51%) and the Takasago Kyoei-kai association (4.05%); GOVERNMENT OF NORWAY holds 1.36%.
short: Takasago Thermal Engineering's top holders as of 30 September 2025: Master Trust 10.29%, Nippon Life 6.83%.
